syllabus.title: AITS:3 Syllabus
syllabus.content:
📌 PHYSICS
• Oscillations, Waves, Electric Charges and Fields, Electrostatic Potential and Capacitance+AITS-2.

📌 CHEMISTRY
• Equilibrium, Electrochemistry, Organic Chemistry: Isomerism, Organic Chemistry: General Organic Chemistry, Hydrocarbon + AITS-2.

📌 BOTANY
• Plant Kingdom, Morphology of Flowering Plants, Anatomy of Flowering Plants + AITS-2.

📌 ZOOLOGY
• Animal Kingdom, Human Reproduction + AITS-2.
